annotations.title: Estimate a posts campaign (engagement, sale, launch, holiday or your own goal; from a store or the brand)

description:
[read-only] Plans a campaign arc from a brief (goal, dates, offer, products or source "brand" with the optional interview, platforms): every post slot with its phase and time, and the most Embers generating its drafts can cost. Creates nothing and charges nothing — use it to show the user the plan and the price before creating. The default goal is "engagement" (no offer, price or deadline needed); for the user's own goal pass goal "custom" with customGoal (their sentence, optional successMeasures and template). With no store, pass source "brand": the posts come from the brand, its Library and the optional interview.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/campaigns/builder/estimate.)

brandId.description: Brand to act in. A brand-bound key acts in its own brand (another brandId is 403); an account-wide key defaults to the owner's active brand.

customGoal.description: Create your own goal (goal "custom"): the goal in the owner's words, used as the campaign goal in every caption prompt. A bare string is the text. Phases follow the closest built-in template (by the config's keywords) unless `template` picks one.

successMeasures.description: Success-measure ids from the config: comments, replies, saves, shares, link_clicks, messages, sign_ups, visits, sales.

template.description: The built-in template to plan with. Default: the closest one to the text.

text.description: One sentence, e.g. "Get more people to book a free consultation".

goal.description: Picks the arc phases and default platforms. A goal id from the campaign builder config: built in are "engagement", "sale", "launch", "holiday" (admins can add more without a deploy), or "custom" with customGoal. Default: "custom" when customGoal is set, else the configured default goal ("engagement"). Engagement needs no offer, price or deadline.

interview.description: Brand campaigns only, every answer optional: what the business is promoting or talking about this month, anything coming up, and who the posts are for.

promoting.description: What are you promoting or talking about this month?

offer.description: Required, with a headline, for a store campaign whose goal needs an offer (sale, launch, holiday). Optional for engagement and custom goals, and for a brand campaign (its headline falls back to the "promoting" answer, then a configured focus). Captions state when the offer ends only when it has endsAt or a discountPercent (a discount ends with the campaign). startsAt / endsAt are the offer's own days when it runs on only some of the campaign's days (Cyber Week: campaign Mon 11/23 – Tue 12/1, offer Fri 11/27 – Mon 11/30): the teaser and countdown are planned before startsAt, the last-chance post on the day of endsAt and the thank-you after it. Without them the offer days are the campaign's days.

endsAt.description: Last instant of the offer; captions state it as the end. Use a date-time with an offset; a bare date is read as UTC midnight.

noSale.description: The campaign is not a sale: captions state no discount, code, free shipping or end, even when those fields are set.

startsAt.description: First instant of the offer. Use a date-time with an offset; a bare date is read as UTC midnight.

requireReview.description: Hold booked posts for review before they go live.

platforms.description: Platform ids (instagram, tiktok, …). Empty = the configured platforms for the goal.

products.description: Featured products (at most the configured product cap). Shopify: {source:"shopify", productGid}. Others: {source:"manual"|"url", title, price?, url?, imageUrl?, description?}.

source.description: What the posts are built from. "store" (default): the featured products. "brand": no store needed — the brand kit and voice, the website, the Library and post themes, plus the optional interview. A brand campaign sends no products and needs no offer (set offer.noSale unless it is a deal); it works with any goal, including "engagement" and "custom".

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. America/New_York. Default: the workspace's.
